cves.description: A flaw has been found in Comfast CF-N1-S 2.6.0.1. This affects the function get_para_from_uri of the file /cgi-bin/mbox-config of the component URI Parameter Parsing. This manipulation of the argument width/height causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely.
